Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a surcharge to fund affordable housing.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a surcharge to fund affordable housing; andadding a new section to chapter 36.22 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.22 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If authorized by the county legislative authority, in additionto the surcharges authorized in RCW 36.22.178, 36.22.179, and36.22.1791, and except as provided in subsection (2) of this section,the county auditor shall charge an additional surcharge of up to twentydollars for each document recorded, which is in addition to any othercharge allowed by law. The county may retain up to five percent ofthese funds collected solely for the collection, administration, andlocal distribution of these funds. All of the remaining fundsgenerated by this surcharge must be retained by the county anddeposited into a fund that must be used by the county for any of thepurposes, and to effectuate any of the powers, for which housingauthorities are authorized under chapter 35.82 RCW. p. 1 HB 1934 (2) The surcharge imposed in this section does not apply toassignments or substitutions of previously recorded deeds of trust.
